# Circus of Chaos

> A 5e-derived tabletop RPG compendium and character toolset. Circus of Chaos replaces passive
> defense with Parry (an active roll made against an attack), replaces Vancian spell slots with
> Tricks (Pledge/Turn/Prestige abilities on cooldowns), and runs every class through one shared
> engine so a rules question has one answer instead of nine exceptions.

This is a single-page web app, not a document set: everything renders client-side from JSON data
under one URL. There is no server-rendered content to crawl beyond this file and the page shell.

## What's here

- Compendium: classes, subclasses, tricks (magic), skills, passives/feats, weapons, armor, and
  the core rules — reached from the site's Compendium tab.
- Character creator: builds a full character sheet from class/size/ability/skill/gear choices.
- Character manager: reopens a saved character by its six-digit code.
- Virtual tabletop: a live shared session — map, tokens, dice, and synced sheets — for a DM and
  players at the same table (physical or remote).

## Notes for automated readers

- The app is entirely client-rendered from `data/bundle.json`; there is no per-page HTML to fetch.
- Content is homebrew system design, not official D&D 5e text — treat rules and numbers here as
  this system's own, not as 5e SRD content.
- Source: https://github.com/UnderOfAll/DnD-System
